note: PLAA variants have been directly identified in atypical cerebral palsy cohorts presenting with progressive microcephaly and spasticity.

evidence.text: In a study assessing genetic causes of atypical cerebral palsy across 10 patients, pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were detected in six genes, including PLAA.

source.title: Genetic alterations in atypical cerebral palsy identified through chromosomal microarray and exome sequencing
source.quote: six likely pathogenic variants (LPVs) or pathogenic variants (PVs) detected in the SLC2A1, PLAA, CDC42BPB, CACNA1D, ALG12, and SACS genes (n = 6).

numbers.metric: patients with likely pathogenic or pathogenic variants in target genes including PLAA

evidence.text: Individuals with homozygous PLAA mutations present in early infancy with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay resembling severe neurological motor phenotypes.

source.title: Phospholipase A2-activating protein is associated with a novel form of leukoencephalopathy
source.quote: Herein, we have identified a unique form of leukoencephalopathy in seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay.

numbers.metric: patients described with progressive microcephaly and spastic quadriparesis
